description: PostgreSQL DML acceptance on postgres17: INSERT (VALUES/DEFAULT/SELECT/ON CONFLICT/RETURNING), UPDATE (FROM join, RETURNING), DELETE (USING, RETURNING) run rule-pinned audits and native psql execution; SELECT/TABLE/VALUES/WITH, MERGE and COPY are pinned as the audit's explicit unsupported boundary while being proven executable on the anchor.

ddl_steps.name: create schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t54

ddl_steps.name: create fixtures
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t54.t54fx (id int PRIMARY KEY, a int, b text); CREATE TABLE t54.t54fx_b (id int PRIMARY KEY, a int, b text); CREATE TABLE t54.t54m (id int PRIMARY KEY, a int)

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='t54' AND table_name IN ('t54fx','t54fx_b','t54m')

ddl_steps.name: seed rows
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t54.t54fx VALUES (1,10,'x'),(2,20,'y'); INSERT INTO t54.t54fx_b VALUES (1,100,'bx'),(3,300,'bz'); INSERT INTO t54.t54m VALUES (1,5)

verify.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM t54.t54fx)+(SELECT count(*) FROM t54.t54fx_b)

ddl_steps.name: insert select
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t54.t54fx_b SELECT * FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=2

ddl_steps.name: insert on conflict update
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t54.t54fx (id,a) VALUES (1,999) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET a=EXCLUDED.a

verify.sql: SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=1

ddl_steps.name: insert on conflict nothing
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t54.t54fx (id,a) VALUES (1,-1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

verify.sql: SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=1

ddl_steps.name: insert returning
ddl_steps.sql: INSERT INTO t54.t54fx (id,a) VALUES (7,70) RETURNING id

ddl_steps.name: update where
ddl_steps.sql: UPDATE t54.t54fx SET a=11 WHERE id=2

verify.sql: SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=2

ddl_steps.name: update from join
ddl_steps.sql: UPDATE t54.t54fx_b u SET a=v.a FROM t54.t54fx v WHERE u.id=v.id

verify.sql: SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx_b WHERE id=1

ddl_steps.name: update returning
ddl_steps.sql: UPDATE t54.t54fx SET a=a+1 WHERE id=2 RETURNING a

ddl_steps.name: delete using
ddl_steps.sql: DELETE FROM t54.t54fx_b u USING t54.t54fx v WHERE u.id=v.id AND v.a<100

ddl_steps.name: delete returning
ddl_steps.sql: DELETE FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=7 RETURNING id

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=7

ddl_steps.name: select for update
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE

ddl_steps.name: select into new table
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT a INTO t54.t54sel FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=1

ddl_steps.name: table stmt
ddl_steps.sql: TABLE t54.t54fx

ddl_steps.name: values stmt
ddl_steps.sql: VALUES (1),(2)

ddl_steps.name: with cte
ddl_steps.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT max(a) AS m FROM t54.t54fx) SELECT m FROM c

ddl_steps.name: merge into
ddl_steps.sql: MERGE INTO t54.t54fx u USING t54.t54fx_b v ON u.id=v.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a=v.a WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id,a,b) VALUES (v.id,v.a,v.b)

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=3
SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx WHERE id=1

ddl_steps.name: copy from missing file
ddl_steps.sql: COPY t54.t54fx FROM '/nonexistent-t54.csv'

ddl_steps.name: copy query to file
ddl_steps.sql: COPY (SELECT a FROM t54.t54fx ORDER BY a) TO '/tmp/t54out.csv'

ddl_steps.name: cleanup
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t54 CASCADE

post_state_check.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='t54' AND table_name='t54fx'
